title: Al-Balad 90:8-14 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: Al-Fajr and the families of madd
source: Written for quran/y4 lesson 21 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Balad 90:8-14 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 21. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: أَلَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُۥ عَيْنَيْنِ (٨) وَلِسَانًۭا وَشَفَتَيْنِ (٩) وَهَدَيْنَٰهُ ٱلنَّجْدَيْنِ (١٠) فَلَا ٱقْتَحَمَ ٱلْعَقَبَةَ (١١) وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْعَقَبَةُ (١٢) فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ (١٣) أَوْ إِطْعَٰمٌۭ فِى يَوْمٍۢ ذِى مَسْغَبَةٍۢ (١٤)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: Have We not made for him two eyes?
And a tongue and two lips?
And have shown him the two ways?
But he has not broken through the difficult pass.
And what can make you know what is [breaking through] the difficult pass?
It is the freeing of a slave
Or feeding on a day of severe hunger

head: Word
Where
Rule
How to read it
rows: Hamzat al-wasl: alif not read when joined

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Balad 90:8-14 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 90:8-14 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 90:8-14 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Find the dual words (ending -ayn, meaning 'two') in 90:8 to 10.
Explain in one sentence what 'the two ways' (90:10) are.
questions.a: The way of good and the way of evil: Allah showed us both so we can choose.

questions.q: What is 'the difficult pass' (al-'aqabah) explained as in 90:13 to 14?
options: Freeing a slave or feeding the hungry
questions.a: A) Freeing a slave or feeding the hungry. 90:13 to 14: the freeing of a slave, or feeding on a day of severe hunger.

questions.q: Think again: Allah gave us two eyes, a tongue and two lips (90:8 to 9). What is one good thing you did with each today?
questions.a: Eyes: read the Qur'an; tongue: kind words, dhikr; lips: a smile. Each is a blessing to use well.
